item.title: ネタニヤフ氏、イランが息子殺害を企図と発言 詳細は明らかにせず
item.description: [テルアビブ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[テルアビブ ２４日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は２４日、イランが自身の息子の１人を殺害しようとしたと明らかにした。計画がいつ行われたのか、どの息子が標的だったのか、また実行にどの程度近づいていたのかに関する詳細は示していない。

１０月２７日の総選挙を控え、世論調査ではネタニヤフ氏が率いる連立与党は劣勢に立たされている。こうした中でネタニヤフ氏は、保守系テレビ局「チャンネル１４」との電話インタビューで、イスラエルの治安機関の１つが選挙を前に政敵への警護提供を拒否したとの報道について質問を受け、これに答える形で発言した。

ネタニヤフ氏は「息子たちについて言えば実に信じ難いことだが、イランは私の息子の１人を標的にした。イランは私の息子の１人を標的にしようとした。イランは私の息子を殺害しようとした。だからこそ警護はぜいたくではない」と強調したが、計画の詳細や実行可能性を巡る説明はしなかった。またどの息子を指しているのかは明らかになっていない。長男のヤイル氏は米南部フロリダ州マイアミに居住している。

国連のイラン代表部は、この主張に関するコメント要請に回答しなかった。

一方、ネタニヤフ氏は、国内治安機関シンベトのジニ長官に対し、首相候補者全員に適切な警護を提供するよう伝えたとも表明した。

これに先立ちイスラエルのメディアは、ジニ氏が次期首相有力候補の１人と目されるガディ・アイゼンコット氏への警護提供を拒否し、選挙管理当局に対して、同氏に危害を加える計画は確認されていないと説明したと報じていた。

国防軍元参謀総称のアイゼンコット氏が所属する政党は、総選挙で最多議席を獲得する見通しとされている。

item.title: Brasileño Fonseca se retira de Abierto de EEUU por lesión
item.description: El brasileño João Fonseca dijo el lunes que no competirá en el Abierto de Estados Unidos debido a una lesión abdominal, en otra baja de renombre en el cuadro de individuales masculino.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: El brasileño João Fonseca dijo el lunes que no competirá en el Abierto de Estados Unidos debido a una lesión abdominal, en otra baja de renombre en el cuadro de individuales masculino. El jugador de 20 años, número 26 del ranking, era una de las grandes promesas en Flushing Meadows tras su sensacional trayectoria hasta los cuartos de final del Abierto de Francia de este año, donde venció a Novak Djokovic y a Casper Ruud. "Tras someterme a pruebas y comenzar el tratamiento para mi lesión abdominal, mi equipo y yo tuvimos claro que necesito más tiempo para recuperarme por completo y poder competir al máximo nivel", afirmó Fonseca en Instagram. "No ha sido una decisión fácil de tomar, ya que es un torneo muy especial para mí. Seguiremos trabajando duro para que pueda volver lo antes posible". El número uno del mundo, Jannik Sinner, y el británico Jack Draper se retiraron del torneo la semana pasada por lesión. El exnúmero cuatro del mundo Holger Rune tampoco participará en el torneo. El cuadro principal de individuales masculinos comienza el domingo.

item.title: Boeing awarded contract with ceiling value of $131.2 billion for F-15 program
item.description: The U.S. Department of War on Monday awarded Boeing a $131.23 billion indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) contract to support the F-15 Eagle Crest program, which oversees the F-15 fighter aircraft fleet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Department of War on Monday awarded Boeing a $131.23 billion indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) contract to support the F-15 Eagle Crest program, which oversees the F-15 fighter aircraft fleet. The contract covers aircraft production, systems integration, upgrades and sustainment, including new organic depot maintenance aimed at keeping F-15 aircraft mission-ready for the U.S. Air Force, Air National Guard and other Department of War customers. The work will be performed at St. Louis, Missouri, and is expected to be completed by August 2037, the department said in its website. The ordering period runs through August 24, 2031, with an option to extend it through August 24, 2036. The contract also covers Foreign Military Sales to Japan, Israel, Saudi Arabia, South Korea, Singapore, Indonesia and Poland. The contract was awarded on a sole-source basis.

item.title: 米がシリアのテロ支援国家指定解除、投資促進へ最後の障壁なくなる
item.description:
Feras Dalatey
[ダマスカス ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Feras Dalatey

[ダマスカス ２４日 ロイター] - 米国は２４日、シリアをテロ支援国家指定リストから正式に解除した。シリア暫定政府はこれにより、同国への投資を妨げていた最後の大きな障壁が取り除かれたとしており、今後は米・シリアの関係強化がさらに進む見通しだ。

米財務省のウェブサイトで公表された解除措置は、トランプ米大統領が７月８日に議会へ指定解除の意向を正式通知した後、４５日間の議会審査期間が終了したことを受けて発効した。

ルビオ米国務長官は声明で解除措置について「シャラア暫定大統領率いるシリア政府が国際テロ行為との完全な決別に向けて前向きな行動を取り、さらなる取り組みを約束したことを評価した」と述べた。

シリアのシェイバニ外相は２３日ロイターに、今回の解除が「最後の障害」を取り除くことで、シリアの世界的な金融・経済システムへの再統合や投資拡大につながるとの期待を示した上で「もはやシリアへの投資や事業展開、経済生活の再建を妨げる障害は存在しない」と語った。

シリアは１９７９年、故ハフェズ・アサド大統領政権が武装組織を支援しているとして米国からテロ支援国家に指定された。その後、息子のバッシャール・アサド政権下でも指定は維持されたが、同政権は２０２４年１２月に打倒された。

今回の発表では、シャラア氏が率いる旧反体制派シャーム解放機構（ＨＴＳ、旧ヌスラ戦線）に対する「特別指定国際テロ組織（ＳＤＧＴ）」の指定も解除された。

テロ支援国家指定は米国の対外援助や防衛装備品の輸出・売却、一部の軍民両用物資の取引、金融取引などに制限を課すもので、米国がシリアに対する広範な制裁を解除した後も、銀行や投資家にとって大きなリスク要因となっていた。

シリア政府は、約１４年に及んだ内戦からの復興に向けて数十億ドル規模の投資を必要としており、指定解除前から海外企業の関心が高まっていた。

シリア財務省によると、バルニエ財務相は今月、バンク・オブ・アメリカ幹部と協力の可能性やシリアの国際金融システムへの再統合について協議。同行側はシリア訪問と協議継続への意欲を示したという。また米決済大手マスターカードは５月、カタールのＱＮＢグループやシリア中央銀行と協力し、国際カード決済インフラ整備を進めていると発表した。

トランプ氏は７月にトルコ首都のアンカラでシャラア氏と会談した後、議会へ送付した書簡で、シリア復興を妨げる「あらゆる障壁を取り除く」と約束していた。

指定解除に先立ち、米・シリア両国は数カ月間、経済・外交政策を巡る協議を継続しており、ロイターは今月、協議に詳しい関係者３人の話として、シリアがテロ支援国家指定解除に向けた交渉の中で、ロシア産原油の輸入を大幅に削減する方針で合意したと報じた。

item.title: Fonseca pulls out of US Open injured
item.description: Brazil's Joao Fonseca has pulled out of the U.S. Open due to an abdominal injury, the 20-year-old said on Instagram on Monday, marking the latest high-profile absence in the men's singles field.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Brazil's Joao Fonseca has pulled out of the U.S. Open due to an abdominal injury, the 20-year-old said on Instagram on Monday, marking the latest high-profile absence in the men's singles field. The 26th-ranked player was among the hot tickets in Flushing Meadows after his [USN:L1N42A165 TEXT:"sensational run"] to the French Open quarter-finals this year, where he beat Novak Djokovic and Casper Ruud. "After undergoing tests and starting treatment for my abdomen, it became clear to me and my team that I need more time to fully recover so I can compete at a high level," said Fonseca. "It was not an easy decision to make, as it is a very special tournament for me. We'll keep working hard so I can come back as soon as possible." World number one Jannik Sinner and Briton Jack Draper withdrew from the tournament [USN:L6N44I0TR TEXT:"last week"] due to injury. Former world number four Holger Rune will also miss the event. The men's singles main draw begins on Sunday.

item.title: Hodgkinson withdraws from Zurich Diamond League, says body not ready
item.description: Olympic champion Keely Hodgkinson has withdrawn from Thursday's 800 metres at the Diamond League meeting in Zurich, saying her body was not ready to race again after the European Championships.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Olympic champion Keely Hodgkinson has withdrawn from Thursday's 800 metres at the Diamond League meeting in Zurich, saying her body was not ready to race again after the European Championships. The Briton had been due to face European champion Audrey Werro in a rematch of their Birmingham final, where [USN:L1N44B0YJ TEXT:"the Swiss won gold"] in a championship-record 1:54.81. "Unfortunately the body isn't quite ready to race again after the European Championships," Hodgkinson said in a statement. "We've made the decision to skip this race and get ready for the next one." Hodgkinson, who won Olympic gold at the Paris 2024 Games, has also withdrawn from a busy summer schedule after dealing with injuries in recent seasons. Werro, who won the 800m at last week's Diamond League meeting in Lausanne, will still compete in Zurich alongside Britain's Georgia Hunter Bell and Dutch 400m hurdles world champion Femke Broeders-Bol. The Zurich meeting is the penultimate Diamond League event of the season, with the series final scheduled for Brussels on September 4 to 5.

item.title: Corte Suprema EEUU elimina un obstáculo judicial a restricciones de Trump sobre el voto por correo
item.description: La Corte Suprema de Estados Unidos revocó el lunes una resolución judicial que impedía al Gobierno aplicar un decreto para restringir el uso de las papeletas de voto por correo para las elecciones de noviembre, que decidirán el control del Congreso, aunque sigue vigente otra resolución.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung
item.content:encoded: La Corte Suprema de Estados Unidos revocó el lunes una resolución judicial que impedía al Gobierno aplicar un decreto para restringir el uso de las papeletas de voto por correo para las elecciones de noviembre, que decidirán el control del Congreso, aunque sigue vigente otra resolución. Los magistrados accedieron a una solicitud de emergencia del Departamento de Justicia para suspender una orden que la jueza federal Indira Talwani había dictado en junio para impedir que Donald Trump llevara a cabo su directiva en una coalición de 23 estados, en su mayoría gobernados por demócratas, y Washington D. C., que habían presentado una demanda para impedirla. El tribunal cuenta con una mayoría conservadora de 6 a 3. Los tres magistrados liberales se mostraron en desacuerdo con la decisión, que deja la puerta abierta a que los estados vuelvan a presentar demandas en los próximos meses. El decreto ordenaba al Departamento de Seguridad Nacional que recopilara y transmitiera a los estados una lista de ciudadanos estadounidenses con derecho a voto en cada estado, y al Departamento de Justicia que diera prioridad a la investigación y el enjuiciamiento de los funcionarios electorales estatales y locales que entregaran papeletas a personas consideradas "no aptas" para votar en las elecciones federales. Asimismo, exigía al Servicio Postal que entregara las papeletas únicamente a los votantes que figuraran en la lista aprobada por cada estado para el voto por correo. El Servicio Postal ha tomado recientemente medidas para aplicar la directiva de Trump. El mandatario se ha comprometido a poner fin al uso de las papeletas por correo en todo el país antes de las elecciones de mitad de legislatura, y lleva tiempo poniendo en duda la seguridad de dichas papeletas, aunque las pruebas de fraude electoral son escasas. Los republicanos pretenden mantener el control del Congreso. Restringir el voto por correo beneficiaría de manera desproporcionada a los republicanos, dado que los votantes demócratas suelen recurrir al voto por correo con mayor frecuencia que los votantes republicanos. En junio, Talwani dictaminó que el presidente carecía de autoridad para ordenar cambios en la forma en que los estados administran las elecciones federales, señalando que, según la Constitución, corresponde a los estados determinar los requisitos de elegibilidad de los votantes. La jueza también señaló que las agencias federales carecen de la capacidad para elaborar listas precisas de ciudadanos para cada estado. El Departamento de Justicia había afirmado que la demanda que impugnaba la directiva de Trump era prematura y que los estados no tenían la legitimación necesaria en esta fase para interponerla. Las agencias aún no han tomado ninguna medida concreta que afecte a los estados, por lo que cualquier perjuicio que aleguen es especulativo, afirmó el Gobierno. Los estados sostienen que sus alegaciones no son hipotéticas y que "el apresurado intento del Gobierno de cambiar las normas del voto por correo en vísperas de las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre corre el riesgo de privar del derecho al voto a un número considerable de votantes".

item.title: Report: Northwestern names Aidan Chiles starting QB
item.description: Northwestern named Aidan Chiles as its starting quarterback, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Northwestern named Aidan Chiles as its starting quarterback, ESPN reported Monday. Chiles started 20 games for Michigan State over the past two seasons. He transferred to Northwestern following last season. Chiles passed for 3,807 yards and 23 touchdowns and was intercepted 14 times in his time with the Spartans. Chiles began his career at Oregon State, where he passed for 309 yards and four scores in 2023 before following Jonathan Smith to Michigan State when Smith became the Spartans' coach. Smith was fired after Michigan State went 4-8 last season, including 1-8 in Big Ten play, and Chiles was soon on the move. Chiles beat out Ryan Boe (20 college passing attempts over two seasons) and West Virginia transfer Nicco Marchiol (1,462 yards, 10 TDs over four seasons) for the Northwestern starting gig. Northwestern's new offensive coordinator is Chip Kelly, the former head coach for Oregon and UCLA. He also was offensive coordinator when Ohio State won the 2024 national title. Northwestern opens the season on Sept. 5 against visiting South Dakota State. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Blazers G Shaedon Sharpe (knee) out 6 months
item.description: Coming off a career-best scoring season, Portland Trail Blazers guard Shaedon Sharpe is expected to miss six months after suffering a torn meniscus in his right knee, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Coming off a career-best scoring season, Portland Trail Blazers guard Shaedon Sharpe is expected to miss six months after suffering a torn meniscus in his right knee, ESPN reported Monday. Sharpe, 23, averaged 20.8 points, 4.3 rebounds and 2.6 assists in 2025-26, helping Portland to its first postseason appearance since 2021 despite missing 32 games with a stress fracture of his left fibula. The report said Sharpe's injury occurred during a recent workout session. Entering his fifth season, Portland's first-round pick (No. 7 overall) in the 2022 NBA Draft has averaged 15.7 points, 4.0 rebounds and 2.2 assists in 234 games (134 starts). Sharpe is set to earn approximately $20 million this season in the first year of a four-year, $90 million extension he signed last year. Despite Sharpe's injury, the Trail Blazers are not lacking for talent at the guard position with veterans Damian Lillard, Ja Morant and Jrue Holiday manning the position along with fourth-year player Scoot Henderson. --Field Level Media

item.title: US appeals court considers reassigning case from judge over AI use
item.description: A U.S. appeals court has asked to hear arguments over whether a lower court judge in Mississippi should be reassigned from a case after he issued an order containing errors stemming from the use of AI.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: A U.S. appeals court has asked to hear arguments over whether a lower court judge in Mississippi should be reassigned from a case after he issued an order containing errors stemming from the use of AI. A 5th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals panel on Friday asked lawyers in the case to be prepared at an upcoming hearing to address whether it should be assigned to a different district judge, “especially in light of the use of AI by the district court.” U.S. District Judge Henry Wingate in Jackson, Mississippi, was one of two judges who admitted in response to [USN:L2N3VN0JU TEXT:"an inquiry"] by U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman Chuck Grassley last year that members of their staff used AI to prepare court orders in unrelated cases that Grassley called "error-ridden." Both judges said the decisions did not go through their chambers' typical review processes before they were issued. Wingate did not immediately respond to a request for comment sent to his court staff on Monday. Lawyers for the state and for the plaintiffs, which include the Jackson Federation of Teachers, did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Monday. Wingate had issued a temporary restraining order in the case on July 20, 2025, that blocked state officials from enforcing a ban on diversity, equity and inclusion programs in state universities and public schools. He then replaced the order after lawyers for the state argued it contained references to made-up material, incorrect plaintiffs and defendants, and other serious errors. He [USN:L1N3TW02C TEXT:"declined"] to give an explanation for the errors at the time. In an October letter to Grassley, Wingate said that a law clerk used AI tool Perplexity "as a foundational drafting assistant to synthesize publicly available information on the docket." He said posting the draft decision "was a lapse in human oversight." The state in the 5th Circuit appeal is challenging a preliminary injunction Wingate issued later in the case. The appeal is set for oral argument on August 31.

item.title: Fronteira dos EUA reabre para gado mexicano, mas persistem preocupações com parasita
item.description: O México está intensificando sua campanha contra a mosca que transmite um parasita que atinge os rebanhos da fronteira norte, onde foram detectados casos recentes, aumentando o rigor na fiscalização das exportações de gado, à medida que o comércio transfronteiriço foi retomado nesta segunda-feira, no âmbito de uma reabertura gradual dos Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: O México está intensificando sua campanha contra a mosca que transmite um parasita que atinge os rebanhos da fronteira norte, onde foram detectados casos recentes, aumentando o rigor na fiscalização das exportações de gado, à medida que o comércio transfronteiriço foi retomado nesta segunda-feira, no âmbito de uma reabertura gradual dos Estados Unidos. A reabertura marca a primeira flexibilização da proibição imposta pelos EUA há mais de um ano para impedir a entrada das larvas devoradoras de tecidos animais, com a retomada inicial das importações pelo Arizona. O plano tem gerado críticas de alguns grupos pecuários dos EUA e de autoridades estaduais, que argumentam que a retomada das importações poderia aumentar os riscos de proliferação da mosca, mesmo com o parasita continuando a se espalhar no norte do México e já tendo sido detectado no Texas e no Novo México. Por outro lado, frigoríficos avaliam que oferta de gado tende a aumentar nos EUA em [USN:L1N44B0SV TEXT:"2027"], ajudando o país a lidar com uma escassez de animais e preços mais altos da arroba bovina. A ministra da Agricultura do México, Columba López, afirmou que as autoridades reforçariam a dispersão de moscas estéreis em Sonora e Chihuahua, uma estratégia-chave de erradicação que visa impedir a reprodução do parasita. A secretária de Agricultura dos EUA, Brooke Rollins, disse aos repórteres na segunda-feira que o USDA considera ter "tomado todas as medidas para proteger o rebanho norte-americano e o consumidor norte-americano; portanto, agora podemos começar lentamente a reabrir os portos". O USDA planeja abrir mais dois portos no Novo México, um em 30 dias e outro em 60 dias, disse Rollins. "Não planejamos abrir nenhum porto no Texas tão cedo, simplesmente porque é lá que está a verdadeira atividade", afirmou Rollins. O USDA identificou 46 casos de larva-de-parafuso no Novo México e no Texas, sendo dois deles ativos atualmente, de acordo com o site da agência. NOVOS CASOS NO MÉXICO Um comunicado no site do USDA na segunda-feira informou que o porto de Douglas, no Arizona, foi reaberto para importações de gado do México "orientado por medidas de segurança complementares e um protocolo de importação com base científica" acordado entre os dois países. O USDA avaliará, em seguida, a reabertura dos portos de Santa Teresa e Columbus, no Novo México, para gado, bisões e cavalos. "A abertura dos portos poderá ser suspensa se o USDA identificar um aumento do risco em Sonora ou Chihuahua por meio de auditorias pós-abertura ou outras observações/informações", informou o site. A reabertura começará com exportações de 700 cabeças de gado por dia durante a primeira semana, aumentando para 900 por dia na segunda semana e subindo gradualmente para cerca de 1.300 por dia, de acordo com a Confederação Nacional de Organizações Pecuárias (CNOG) do México. Se outros pontos de passagem na fronteira de Chihuahua forem reabertos no quarto trimestre, o México poderá exportar até 200 mil cabeças de gado em 2026, com um valor estimado de cerca de US$420 milhões a preços de mercado dos EUA, informou a CNOG. Seu cenário base para 2027 projeta exportações de 1,09 milhão de cabeças de gado, avaliadas em cerca de US$2,1 bilhões no mercado dos EUA. Chihuahua, um dos Estados mais importantes do México na exportação de gado, registrou 183 casos da larva desde a detecção do primeiro caso em julho, enquanto o Estado vizinho de Sonora registrou dois casos confirmados após anunciar sua primeira detecção na semana passada. Sonora ativou protocolos de emergência de vigilância e contenção, enquanto Chihuahua intensificou as inspeções, os controles de movimentação de gado e as campanhas de tratamento para evitar uma maior disseminação.

item.title: Petróleo cai mais de US$2 apesar das novas sanções dos EUA contra o Irã
item.description: Os preços do petróleo caíram mais de US$2 por barril nesta segunda-feira, à medida que os investidores realizaram lucros após os recentes ganhos e não deram importância às novas sanções dos EUA contra o Irã.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo caíram mais de US$2 por barril nesta segunda-feira, à medida que os investidores realizaram lucros após os recentes ganhos e não deram importância às novas sanções dos EUA contra o Irã. Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam com queda de US$2,22, ou 2,35%, a US$92,17, enquanto o petróleo West Texas Intermediate dos EUA caiu US$2,05 por barril, ou 2,35%, para US$85,01. O secretário do Treasury, Scott Bessent, anunciou na segunda-feira uma ampliação das sanções secundárias que podem ser impostas a entidades e países que mantêm laços comerciais com o Irã em todo o mundo, à medida que Washington intensifica significativamente a pressão econômica sobre Teerã, com a guerra se aproximando da marca de seis meses. Isso ocorreu após as ameaças de Trump de "guerra econômica e isolamento em escala sem precedentes" contra Teerã na semana passada. "Não houve muitas novidades no comentário de Bessent, além do que já havia sido divulgado com antecedência", disse Pavel Molchanov, analista de estratégia de investimentos da Raymond James. O mercado de petróleo, que havia se recuperado bastante na semana passada, registrou realização de lucros hoje, acrescentou ele. Ambos os contratos registraram um segundo ganho semanal consecutivo na semana passada, subindo mais de 5%. "Será que a Casa Branca conseguirá propor algo que nunca tenha sido tentado antes e que tenha um efeito muito mais poderoso sobre a economia iraniana? Só acreditaremos quando o virmos", disse Molchanov. "A verdadeira questão agora é até que ponto Washington está disposta a aplicar sanções secundárias de forma agressiva contra os parceiros comerciais restantes do Irã", disse Jorge Leon, chefe de análise geopolítica da Rystad Energy. "A menos que a China reduza significativamente suas compras, o impacto adicional sobre as receitas do petróleo iraniano pode ser relativamente limitado", acrescentou ele. O Irã havia condenado os planos dos EUA de anunciar novas sanções, e o presidente Masoud Pezeshkian havia pedido uma solução diplomática. O chefe do Exército do Paquistão estava em visita a Teerã na segunda-feira para negociações de mediação, antes do anúncio dos EUA. Os embarques de petróleo pelo Estreito de Ormuz, rota que já transportava um quinto do abastecimento global, continuaram restritos. Menos de 20 navios de carga transitaram pelo Estreito de Ormuz no fim de semana, segundo dados de transporte divulgados na segunda-feira, já que os bloqueios iranianos e norte-americanos restringem o tráfego por esse ponto de estrangulamento para o transporte de energia. O presidente-executivo da TotalEnergies, Patrick Pouyanne, disse (TTEF.PA) que a petrolífera estava transportando petróleo de forma lucrativa pelo Estreito de Ormuz, com os custos mais altos de transporte sendo mais do que compensados por descontos significativos oferecidos pelos produtores de petróleo. A Somo, do Iraque, e a QatarEnergy ofereceram petróleo para carregamento dentro do estreito em licitações, segundo operadores. "O preço do Brent a US$93 por barril, em vez de US$120-150, nos indica que há petróleo suficiente fluindo pelo Estreito de Ormuz e do Golfo Pérsico em geral", disse o analista do SEB, Bjarne Schieldrop, à Reuters, acrescentando que um ponto de inflexão poderia ocorrer se o Irã decidisse realmente fechar o Estreito de Ormuz com foguetes e drones. Analistas do Morgan Stanley elevaram suas previsões para o Brent, projetando um pico de US$100 por barril no quarto trimestre. A Agência Internacional de Energia não está discutindo, no momento, uma segunda liberação de petróleo das reservas estratégicas, afirmou seu diretor, Fatih Birol, na segunda-feira.

item.title: UK moves ahead with first £10 billion wave of low-rent housing plan
item.description: Britain's government announced details on Monday of almost £10 billion ($13.63 billion) in funding for the construction of lower-cost housing for renters with a focus on London, one of the areas hit hardest by the country's shortage of homes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's government announced details on Monday of almost £10 billion ($13.63 billion) in funding for the construction of lower-cost housing for renters with a focus on London, one of the areas hit hardest by the country's shortage of homes. More than £7 billion - the first tranche of a previously announced £39 billion in funding over 10 years - was earmarked for the capital where local authorities were expected to deliver over half the new homes, the government said. Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who moved into Downing Street in July, has promised to build more social rent homes, which offer tenants a discount of around 50% to market rates. He says the move will reduce the long-term welfare bill and homelessness as well as provide security to people on lower incomes. "Councils built this country out of a housing crisis once before. Backed properly, and trusted to get on with it, they will do it again," Burnham said in a statement. Over time, more than £16 billion of the total 10-year funding plan will be allocated outside London, the government said. It did not provide an estimate for the total number of homes likely to be built with the first wave of financing because London's allocation has yet to be split between councils in the capital. Around 20,000 new homes in northern English cities were likely to be financed in the first wave. The government said the house-building programme would advance another policy priority of Burnham - devolution - by giving mayoral authorities the power to set strategic direction in their areas. ($1 = 0.7335 pounds)

item.title: EEUU planea revocar visas de turismo y negocios de hasta 200.000 extranjeros: AP
item.description: El Gobierno de Donald Trump se está preparando para revocar los visados de negocios y turismo de hasta 200.000 extranjeros que han solicitado o están solicitando actualmente el estatuto de asilo en Estados Unidos, informó el lunes la agencia Associated Press.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Donald Trump se está preparando para revocar los visados de negocios y turismo de hasta 200.000 extranjeros que han solicitado o están solicitando actualmente el estatuto de asilo en Estados Unidos, informó el lunes la agencia Associated Press. El reporte citaba documentos del Departamento de Estado obtenidos por la AP y a dos funcionarios estadounidenses. Si esta medida se llevara a cabo, sería la mayor revocación masiva de visados de la historia de Estados Unidos, según la AP. Más temprano el lunes, el subsecretario de Estado, Christopher Landau, dijo en X que el sistema de inmigración estadounidense "lleva mucho tiempo desbordado por solicitudes de asilo infundadas". El Departamento de Estado no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Trump ha llevado a cabo una agresiva campaña de represión en materia de inmigración que, según él, tiene como objetivo mejorar la seguridad nacional. Las organizaciones de derechos humanos afirman que esta campaña ha violado los derechos a la libertad de expresión y al debido proceso, y ha creado un entorno inseguro, especialmente para las minorías étnicas, que han expresado su preocupación por la discriminación racial.

item.title: Nevada sues to block Trump administration's Colorado River plan
item.description: Nevada sued the Trump administration on Monday to block its plans for slashing water supplies from the drought-stricken Colorado River, saying it could devastate the state and would violate the laws governing the river.
item.dc:creator: Tom Hals
item.content:encoded: Nevada sued the Trump administration on Monday to block its plans for slashing water supplies from the drought-stricken Colorado River, saying it could devastate the state and would violate the laws governing the river. The Department of the Interior on Friday [USN:L1N44I0LY TEXT:"finalized its plan"] that included a 21% reduction in water from the river to California, Nevada and Arizona for two years starting in 2027. The cuts to the three so-called lower basin states could nearly double after 2028, a move that Arizona and Nevada have said would have huge consequences for their economies. The four so-called upper basin states — Colorado, Utah, New Mexico and Wyoming — face no mandatory cuts under the new 10-year plan to manage the river that provides water to one in 10 Americans and generates power for 6 million people. The plan is up for review every two years and the states were unable to agree on how to share the water after more than three years of talks to replace a plan that expires this year. Upper basin states refused to take mandatory cuts to their water supply from the river, arguing they already face steep reductions due to the decades-long drought in the western United States. The three lower basin states say all seven states that share the river must make cutbacks in water use. The lawsuit by Nevada, the Colorado River Commission of Nevada and the Southern Nevada Water Authority is the first to challenge the plan. It was filed in federal court in Las Vegas and named as defendants the Department of the Interior, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum, the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation and its commissioner, Aubrey Bettencourt. The Interior Department declined to comment and the Bureau of Reclamation did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The lawsuit alleged the administration violated administrative law, environmental law and the group of treaties, agreements and court rulings known as the Law of the River. It said the administration did not comply with requirements to consider reasonable alternatives and foreseeable economic impacts, to fully respond to comments or to adequately analyze mitigation measures. "Consequently, decisionmakers and stakeholders are left to guess at how federal defendants interpret and apply the Law of the River, which all agree governs the proposed action," the lawsuit said.

item.title: Power supply firm Aggreko files for US IPO amid data center boom
item.description: Aggreko has filed for a U.S. initial public offering, the power supply company said on Monday, as it looks to tap investor appetite for energy infrastructure providers due to growing electricity demand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Aggreko has filed for a U.S. initial public offering, the power supply company said on Monday, as it looks to tap investor appetite for energy infrastructure providers due to growing electricity demand. The company intends to list its ordinary shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "AGKO", but did not disclose the number of shares to be offered or the proposed price range. Aggreko's filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission comes as investor interest in the sector has soared on rising electricity demand and higher spending on power infrastructure, partly due to an AI-driven data center boom. Nuclear companies [USN:L6N417008 TEXT:"X-Energy"] (XE.O) and [USN:L4N43I04R TEXT:"Standard Nuclear"] (STDN.N) went public through traditional IPOs this year. Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan and BofA Securities are serving as joint lead bookrunning managers for Aggreko's offering, while Barclays and Morgan Stanley will be bookrunning managers. The Glasgow-headquartered company's revenue grew 28% to about $1.92 billion for the six months ended July 4, helped by strong demand from data centers and other power-intensive industries. The company also recorded a profit from continuing operations of $80 million, compared with a loss of $196 million in the year-ago period. For the year ended January 3, data center-related revenue nearly doubled to $391 million, according to the filing. Aggreko said it had $6 billion in secured net revenue as of July 2026, providing substantial visibility over its future performance. The company, which was taken private in 2021 by investment firms TDR Capital and I Squared Capital, provides temporary power generation, cooling and energy solutions to customers across industries such as utilities, mining, manufacturing and data centers. The power company operates in more than 80 countries, serves over 14,000 customers globally and has about 8,000 employees. It also has more than 17 gigawatts of capacity available across its fleet.

item.title: Former NBA players not eligible for WNBA, sources say
item.description: Two former NBA players who sought to enter the 2027 WNBA draft are not eligible to participate in the women's basketball league, according to sources around the league on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Two former NBA players who sought to enter the 2027 WNBA draft are not eligible to participate in the women's basketball league, according to sources around the league on Monday. Enes Kanter Freedom, who played in the National Basketball Association for over a decade from 2011, and Royce White, who spent one season in the NBA, had each announced their intention to play in the league, claiming to be transgender women. The sources described the move as an effort to sow division within the WNBA and court attention, amid a nationwide firestorm over U.S. President Donald Trump's [USN:L1N4310YB TEXT:"repeated efforts"] to ban transgender women from women's sports. Reuters was not immediately able to reach Kanter Freedom or White for comment. There are no active, openly transgender players in the WNBA, which does not currently have a specific, publicly available policy on transgender participation. The league is in ongoing conversations with stakeholders on the issue. Comments made by Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham in an ESPN interview last month lit the fuse for controversy, with the former second-round pick telling the broadcaster: "I want to protect young girls in a locker room, or young girls in sport who shouldn't have to go against biological men." The remarks prompted outcry from some longstanding fans of the league, who skew more politically liberal, while others rallied to Cunningham's side, with demonstrations in her support popping up outside Fever games. The players' union, the WNBPA, released a statement this month declaring they would not be used as "political pawns". "Hate, abuse, and demonization of any person or group of people, including transgender people, only fuel fear, division, and harm," they said. Kanter Freedom said on social media on Sunday that he was ejected from a game between Chicago Sky and the Fever after getting into a verbal spat with 2022 assists leader Natasha Cloud.

item.title: Manchester City cierra acuerdo con Palmeiras por atacante Allan
item.description: El Manchester City ha llegado a un acuerdo por una cifra de hasta 34,2 millones de libras (46,61 millones de dólares) para fichar al extremo del Palmeiras Allan Elias, informaron el lunes medios británicos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Manchester City ha llegado a un acuerdo por una cifra de hasta 34,2 millones de libras (46,61 millones de dólares) para fichar al extremo del Palmeiras Allan Elias, informaron el lunes medios británicos. Según reportes de la BBC y Sky Sports, el City pagará inicialmente 32 millones de libras por el brasileño de 22 años, con 2 millones de libras adicionales en posibles complementos. Allan, que también juega como centrocampista ofensivo, se incorporó a la cantera del Palmeiras en 2019 y debutó con el primer equipo en enero de 2025. Desde entonces, ha disputado 96 partidos con el club, en los que ha marcado nueve goles y ha dado 12 asistencias, y formó parte del equipo que ganó el Campeonato Paulista en 2024 y 2026. Según la prensa brasileña, se espera que se pierda el partido de cuartos de final de la Copa de Brasil del miércoles contra el Santos, mientras se prepara para el traspaso. Allan sustituirá a su compatriota Savinho, quien, de acuerdo con reportes, está a punto de fichar por el Tottenham Hotspur procedente del City. (1 dólar = 0,7337 libras)

item.title: Marlins activate 1B/OF Kyle Stowers (hamstring) from 10-day IL
item.description: Ahead of their three-game interleague series opener against the Boston Red Sox on Monday, the Miami Marlins activated first baseman/outfielder Kyle Stowers from the 10-day injured list.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ahead of their three-game interleague series opener against the Boston Red Sox on Monday, the Miami Marlins activated first baseman/outfielder Kyle Stowers from the 10-day injured list. Stowers, 28, a first-time All-Star last season, was placed on the IL with a Grade 1 left hamstring strain on Aug. 11, retroactive to Aug. 10. Stowers, who entered Monday batting .242 this season with 16 homers and 52 RBIs in 94 games, started at first base and batted third. "I feel good ... I feel more comfortable this time than I did last time," Stowers said, referring to his IL stint in April for a right hamstring strain that delayed his season debut until April 19. "Mentally, this was my best (IL stint) this time. The last couple times, it was really hard mentally on me. This time I was really bummed, but I made it what it was. It was an injury, didn't make it any deeper than it needed to be. I was a lot more clear-headed this time with the injury. Just took it day by day. I think that was the biggest growth I've made so far." Selected by the Baltimore Orioles in the second round of the 2019 draft, Stowers played parts of three seasons with the Orioles (2022-24) before being dealt to the Marlins. He has hit .249 with 47 homers and 160 RBIs in 328 games. In a corresponding move, the Marlins optioned third baseman Deyvison De Los Santos to Triple-A Jacksonville. The 23-year-old made his major league debut March 29 and is 3-for-9 with a double. The Marlins entered play Monday four games behind the San Diego Padres for the final National League wild-card spot. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jueza EEUU desestima recurso contra la ampliación de las perforaciones en alta mar de Trump
item.description: Una jueza federal de Alaska desestimó el lunes una demanda presentada por grupos ecologistas que impugnaban la decisión del presidente Donald Trump de permitir la perforación en alta mar a lo largo de amplias franjas del litoral que anteriormente estaban protegidas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Una jueza federal de Alaska desestimó el lunes una demanda presentada por grupos ecologistas que impugnaban la decisión del presidente Donald Trump de permitir la perforación en alta mar a lo largo de amplias franjas del litoral que anteriormente estaban protegidas. La jueza federal de distrito Sharon L. Gleason consideró que la demanda presentada por varios grupos, entre ellos el Northern Alaska Environmental Center, era prematura, ya que la perforación no era inminente en las aguas federales que los predecesores de Trump habían declarado zonas prohibidas. Gleason no se pronunció sobre si los presidentes tienen autoridad legal para revocar la exclusión de zonas costeras de la perforación decidida por sus predecesores y dejó la puerta abierta para que las organizaciones vuelvan a presentar su demanda. Earthjustice, una organización de defensa cuyos abogados interpusieron la demanda, afirmó en un comunicado que la organización sigue considerando que las medidas de Trump fueron ilegales y que volvería a presentar el caso si las autoridades federales ampliaran las perforaciones en alta mar. "Este Gobierno ha estado haciendo todo lo que está en su mano para abrir nuestras costas a la explotación de combustibles fósiles. Seguimos manteniendo que el intento del presidente Trump de abrir las zonas retiradas a la concesión de licencias petroleras es ilegal, y tenemos la intención de seguir adelante con esas reclamaciones si las actividades en alta mar se vislumbran en el horizonte", dijo la organización en un comunicado. El Departamento de Justicia no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El expresidente demócrata Joe Biden prohibió nuevas explotaciones de petróleo y gas en alta mar a lo largo de la mayor parte de las costas estadounidenses antes de que Trump asumiera el cargo, aunque la medida se consideró en gran medida simbólica, ya que no afectaba a las zonas donde ya se estaban realizando perforaciones y abarcaba principalmente áreas sin importantes perspectivas de desarrollo. Trump trató de revocar esa medida como parte de una serie de decretos emitidos a las pocas horas de su posesión, destinados a impulsar la producción de petróleo y gas del país —que ya se encontraba en niveles récord— y a desmantelar los esfuerzos de Biden para hacer frente al cambio climático.

item.title: US SEC investigating Situational Awareness trades that led to July meltdown, source says
item.description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the timing of trades that led to steep losses at AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the timing of trades that led to steep losses at AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday. The regulator is also looking into the fund's communications with lenders around its use of leverage for trades, the source said.

item.title: UK's Burnham drops Thames Water administration plan, The Times reports
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has shelved plans to put struggling utility Thames Water into administration amid concerns about the cost and the legal risk involved, the Times reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has shelved plans to put struggling utility Thames Water into administration amid concerns about the cost and the legal risk involved, the Times reported on Monday. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.

item.title: Reports: Texans obtain WR Kayshon Boutte from Patriots
item.description: The Houston Texans are acquiring receiver Kayshon Boutte from the New England Patriots for safety Jaylen Reed and a seventh-round draft pick in 2028, according to multiple reports Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Houston Texans are acquiring receiver Kayshon Boutte from the New England Patriots for safety Jaylen Reed and a seventh-round draft pick in 2028, according to multiple reports Monday. Boutte fills a need after Houston lost second-year pro Jayden Higgins for the season due to a torn ACL sustained on Aug. 18. Boutte, 24, caught 33 passes for 551 yards and a career-high six touchdowns in 14 games (10 starts) last season. In 2024, he established career bests of 43 catches and 589 yards. Overall, Boutte has 78 receptions for 1,159 yards and nine touchdowns in 34 NFL games (23 starts). Reed, 23, played in seven games (one start) as a rookie last season and had 14 tackles and one fumble recovery. He was a sixth-round pick in the 2025 draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Campaña de Lula se plantea restringir contratación de trabajadores autónomos en posible nuevo mandato
item.description: El Gobierno brasileño está evaluando mecanismos para frenar el recurso a trabajadores contratados como personas jurídicas en lugar de como empleados, de cara a una posible reelección del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, dijo el lunes el ministro de Hacienda, Dario Durigan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno brasileño está evaluando mecanismos para frenar el recurso a trabajadores contratados como personas jurídicas en lugar de como empleados, de cara a una posible reelección del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, dijo el lunes el ministro de Hacienda, Dario Durigan. El plan podría reducir al mínimo el déficit de las pensiones en Brasil y proporcionar una mayor protección en materia de seguridad social a los trabajadores, explicó Durigan a Broadcast, el servicio de noticias del periódico local Estadão. "A una empresa en la que el 80% de su plantilla esté contratada como autónomos, se le podría exigir, en su momento, que realice cotizaciones a la seguridad social", afirmó. Los trabajadores contratados como personas jurídicas suelen percibir un salario bruto más elevado, mientras que las empresas se benefician normalmente de unos costos laborales más bajos, ya que no están obligadas a pagar impuestos sobre las nóminas, cotizaciones al fondo de indemnización por despido ni otras prestaciones. Broadcast presentó a Durigan como representante de la campaña presidencial de Lula, quien se presentará a la reelección en las próximas elecciones de octubre. Durigan también abogó por una revisión de los impuestos corporativos citando los debates sobre los impuestos a las nóminas y los intereses sobre el capital, un tipo de remuneración para los accionistas.

item.title: 米原油先物2.3％安、利益確定売り 対イラン制裁強化も反応薄
item.description:
Nicole Jao
［ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター］
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nicole Jao

［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］　 -

米国時間の原油先物は１バレル当たり２ドル超下落した。直近の上昇を受けた投資家の利益確定売りが優勢となり、米政府による対イラン制裁強化も材料視されなかった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が２．２２ドル（２．３５％）安の９２．１７ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．０５ドル（２．３５％）安の８５．０１ドル。

米トランプ政権は２４日、新たな対イラン経済制裁を発表し、イランとのビジネス関係を維持する国や団体に対する二次制裁の対象を拡大した。

item.title: Chelsea start Alonso era with exciting 3-2 win at neighbours Fulham
item.description: Chelsea began life under new coach Xabi Alonso with a breathless 3-2 victory at West London neighbours Fulham in the Premier League on Monday as their exciting front three of Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer all found the net.
item.dc:creator: William Schomberg
item.content:encoded: Chelsea began life under new coach Xabi Alonso with a breathless 3-2 victory at West London neighbours Fulham in the Premier League on Monday as their exciting front three of Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer all found the net. Chelsea got off to a dream start after 31 seconds when Palmer – looking back to his best after struggling with an injury last season – passed to Joao Pedro and the Brazilian flicked the ball over goalkeeper Bernd Leno. It was the quickest goal scored in the opening round of fixtures in the 34-year history of the Premier League. Fulham equalised when Josh King beat goalkeeper Robert Sanchez at his near post in the 24th minute, giving the home fans something to cheer against their fiercest rivals. But two of Chelsea's new signings then combined in the 41st as central defender Maxence Lacroix jinked down the right before cutting the ball back to the club's £117 million ($159.47 million) [USN:L1N43N13K TEXT:"record signing Rogers"], who made no mistake. Four minutes into the second half, Joao Pedro held up the ball in attack and fed Palmer, who angled a shot through Leno's legs, underlining the midfielder's return to form after missing out on a place with England at the World Cup. "It was a difficult season with injuries and whatnot but through the summer and since I've been back I've worked extra hard," Palmer told Sky Sports. "Obviously with the injuries I've had to try and prevent them and work extra hard day in, day out. I know the talent I've got so I can put in performances like that." Fulham's Gonzalo Garcia, on his league debut after signing from Real Madrid, gave the hosts some hope by heading in after Sanchez could only parry a Timothy Castagne shot in the 54th. Fulham then had a great chance to level again through Antonee Robinson in the 78th minute but his chip over a stranded Sanchez went wide and Chelsea held out to claim the points. Chelsea’s Enzo Fernandez – a lynchpin of World Cup runners-up Argentina who has been linked with a move to Manchester City - was greeted with loud boos from the home fans when he came on as a substitute midway through the second half. Alonso's win in his first competitive match since taking over at Stamford Bridge came at the expense of his former Liverpool and Spain teammate Alvaro Arbeloa - similarly making his Premier League debut as a coach - who also briefly succeeded Alonso as Real Madrid manager last season. Alonso will hope midfielder Moises Caicedo and new fullback Marco Palestra, who are both injured, will provide more solidity while Sanchez could face an early challenge from Mike Penders, who has returned to Chelsea from sister club Racing Strasbourg. ($1 = 0.7337 pounds)

item.title: 米、商用・観光ビザ取り消しへ 難民申請者最大20万人対象＝報道
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米トランプ政権は、米国で難民認定を申請済み、もしくは現在申請中の外国人最大２０万人について、商用ビザおよび観光ビザを取り消す準備を進めている。ＡＰ通信が２４日、国務省の文書と米政府高官２人の話として報じた。

実施されることになれば、米史上最大規模のビザ取り消し措置となる可能性があるという。

報道によると、国務省は今後数週間以内に、２０１６年から２６年の間に発行された「Ｂ１」および「Ｂ２」ビザのうち、所持者が難民認定を申請した、あるいは現在申請中のものについて、取り消しを発表する見通し。また、この措置は国土安全保障省と連携して行われるとしている。

ビザの取り消しが必ずしも直ちに強制送還につながるわけではなく、大半は別のカテゴリーに再分類されるものの、ビジネスや観光目的の渡航者としての地位は失われることになるという。

国務省はコメント要請に応じていない。国土安全保障省は国務省に質問するよう求めた。

item.title: Milho atinge maior cotação em 3 anos em Chicago por menor produção nos EUA
item.description: Os contratos futuros do milho dispararam na bolsa de Chicago para máximas de três anos nesta segunda-feira, depois que uma expedição técnica à região produtora de milho e soja dos EUA na semana passada revelou que a safra do cereal do país estava em condições piores do que muitos esperavam.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do milho dispararam na bolsa de Chicago para máximas de três anos nesta segunda-feira, depois que uma expedição técnica à região produtora de milho e soja dos EUA na semana passada revelou que a safra do cereal do país estava em condições piores do que muitos esperavam. O trigo atingiu seu maior nível em cerca de dois anos, à medida que as retaliações mútuas entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia restringiram as exportações dos portos do Mar Negro, embora os futuros tenham reduzido os ganhos no final do pregão. A soja caiu, pressionada pela queda do petróleo, mas as perdas foram limitadas pela forte demanda de exportação pela soja norte-americana. O contrato de milho mais negociado fechou com alta de 7 centavos, a US$5,155, após atingir US$5,2525 por bushel, a maior cotação desde 2023. A maioria dos contratos de milho registrou máximas históricas. "O mercado noturno disparou com a divulgação na sexta-feira, que saiu após o fechamento do pregão", disse Joe Davis, diretor de vendas de commodities da Futures International. A consultoria Pro Farmer estimou na sexta-feira que a produção de milho dos EUA em 2026 ficará bem abaixo das previsões do governo, após uma visita a sete dos principais Estados produtores ter constatado safras abaixo do esperado, prejudicadas pelo clima adverso do verão. A Pro Farmer projetou que os agricultores colheriam uma safra de milho de 15,344 bilhões de bushels, uma queda de 9,9% em relação a 2025, mas ainda assim a terceira maior já registrada, com um rendimento médio de 173,2 bushels por acre. A estimativa da Pro Farmer para os EUA, se concretizada, seria a mais baixa desde 2020. "As pessoas ficaram chocadas ao ver esse número", disse Davis. Os operadores também estão cautelosos quanto à possibilidade de que o fenômeno climático El Niño reduza a produção de milho no Brasil e estão apreensivos quanto à capacidade de exportação da Ucrânia, segundo analistas. O trigo fechou com alta de 0,25 centavo, a US$6,995 o bushel, reduzindo os ganhos após atingir a maior cotação em cerca de dois anos. A soja encerrou com queda de 15,25 centavos, a US$12,2425 o bushel.

item.title: TRADING DAY Tech, tariffs & Treasuries
item.description: U.S. bond yields fell and tech weighed on U.S. stocks on Monday, as investors digested a raft of economic measures and developments coming out of Washington: U.S. Treasury's plans to increase buybacks of long-dated bonds, new 'economic D-Day' sanctions to isolate Iran, and the threat of new tariffs on Canada.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded: U.S. bond yields fell and tech weighed on [USN:L4N44L0KA TEXT:"U.S. stocks"] on Monday, as investors digested a raft of economic measures and developments coming out of Washington: U.S. Treasury's plans to increase [USN:L1N44H0RB TEXT:"buybacks"] of long-dated bonds, new [USN:L1N44L0ES TEXT:"'economic D-Day'"] sanctions to isolate Iran, and the threat of new tariffs on [USN:L8N44L114 TEXT:"Canada"]. In my column today, I look at whether U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent faces a [USN:L6N44K07X TEXT:"credibility problem"]. The evidence is mounting — the Treasury's recent surprise FX and bond market interventions have unnerved investors, and by Bessent's own stated goals of reducing the deficit and lowering bond yields, he is falling short. If you have more time to read, here are a few articles I recommend to help you make sense of what happened in markets today. [USN:S8N40O00O TEXT:"US unveils 'economic D-Day' of sanctions to isolate Iran"] [USN:L8N44L114 TEXT:"Trump threatens 50% tariffs on all cars and trucks from Canada amid trade fight"] [USN:L6N44H0PG TEXT:"Bond market anxiety raises stakes for Warsh's debut Jackson Hole speech"] [USN:L6N44I0M9 TEXT:"Traders are bracing for an increasingly hawkish ECB"] [USN:P8N43T02S TEXT:"Alibaba shares slide after $10.2 billion AI share sale offered at sharp discount"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Asia in the red (KOSPI -3%, Nikkei -0.7%), [USN:L6N44L0CP TEXT:"Europe"] flat, UK +0.4%, Wall Street mixed (Dow +0.3%, S&P 500 -0.3%, Nasdaq -0.8%) SECTORS/SHARES: Eight sectors on the S&P 500 rise, three fall. Comms services, financials, utilities, consumer staples up 1% or more, tech -1.6%. Nvidia -3%; Seagate, SanDisk, Micron all down ~6%. Expedia +5.5%, Visa +3%, Walmart +2.7%. FX: [USN:L1N44L018 TEXT:"Dollar"] +0.2%, its best day in two weeks. CAD is biggest G10 loser on new tariffs. Bitcoin extends rally, +2% to nudge $80k. Bitcoin +25% in just over a week. BONDS: U.S. yields down 5 bps at long end, curve flattens. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N44K03U TEXT:"Oil"] -2.5%, only its second fall in 14 sessions. [USN:L4N44L00O TEXT:"Gold"] +1% to highest since mid-May. Today's Talking Points: Vigilance against the vigilantes U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent seems to be stepping up the fight against the "bond vigilantes". CNBC reported on Monday that part of his arsenal could be cash at the Treasury General Account to fund the purchase of longer-dated bonds instead of issuing short-term bills. Markets seemed to give the idea the thumbs up, with the 30-year yield falling 5 basis points and the curve flattening. But is the TGA really a longer-term source of funding for what Bessent last week called a "Treasury Twist"? Apart from emergencies, Treasury wants a chunky TGA balance. Bill issuance is rising, and so too is Treasury's reliance on bills for funding. This increases rollover risk, which necessitates a larger TGA buffer. Leaning more heavily on short-term bill issuance and simultaneously reducing cash on hand to mitigate rollover risk would seem to be a counter-intuitive and dicey proposition. Tariff tremors Talking of firepower, U.S. President Donald Trump has loaded up the tariff guns again, and is turning them on an ally, neighbor, and key trading partner Canada. Trump is threatening to impose 50% levies on certain Canadian goods, including all cars, trucks and auto parts. These duties will kick in on January 1 next year if no agreement is reached by then. Canada is not flinching. Not yet, anyway. Prime Minister Mark Carney has retaliated with "dollar for dollar" tariffs on imports of U.S. steel, electronics and other products, to take effect on September 8. Trump's approval ratings are at an all-time low, and with the midterms looming, perhaps he feels the need to flex some muscle on the international stage. For his part, perhaps Carney senses Trump's domestic vulnerability so is taking up the fight. Either way, relations between the two countries are deteriorating. Ace in the Jackson Hole Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will deliver the keynote address at the Kansas City Fed's annual Jackson Hole symposium on Friday. The eyes of the financial world are on him. Warsh wants to improve the Fed communications strategy, but only three months into his tenure, his communications have raised more questions than answers. How does he plan to get inflation back to target? How committed is he to the 2% inflation goal? Will he resist President Trump's demand for lower interest rates? His task has arguably been complicated by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who last week said Treasury will temporarily expand buybacks of long-dated bonds. Essentially, Treasury wants to get yields down, juice GDP, and grow the economy out of the debt hole it's in. But this is inflationary, and inflation has already been above target for more than five years. Warsh has said bond yields are a useful signal, and Bessent wants to actively massage them lower. Contradictions that require clearer communication. What could move markets tomorrow?
